notes: Official CSO July 2026 origin-specific national material-price table and governorate construction-worker wages; hourly normalization uses an explicit 8-hour workday. The price and wage fields remain statistical benchmarks, not quotes or installed rates.

iraq.cso.regional-materials-wages-2026-0.publisher: Iraqi Ministry of Planning, Central Statistical Organization, Construction and Building Statistics Directorate
iraq.cso.regional-materials-wages-2026-0.access: Official July 2026 construction-material and worker-wage bulletin. Material table reports thousand IQD and origin-specific national-market categories; worker wages are IQD/person/workday by the 15 listed governorates. Material rates are not exact grades, supplier quotations, delivered prices or installed rates. Hourly wages below normalize the published daily rates using an explicit 8-hour workday and exclude employer burden. The foreign-origin rebar footnote identifies Iranian/Turkish origin as most common in that category; other origin classes are not manufacturer identity.
iraq.cso.regional-materials-wages-2026-0.price_table_unit: thousand IQD as printed; normalized to IQD by multiplying by 1,000
iraq.cso.regional-materials-wages-2026-0.geographic_scope: Materials: national market by reported origin class; wages: 15 governorates reported by CSO, Kurdistan Region not included

iraq.scosi-extrusion-press-components-20.publisher: State Company for Steel Industries, Iraqi Ministry of Industry and Minerals
iraq.scosi-extrusion-press-components-20.access: Official company item dated 2026-03-11 reports its workshop supplied fabricated components (including cast holder, X40 pressure disc and press head) for a private 1,100-ton aluminium extrusion press; workshop rehabilitation/opening was reported in 2025. This supports a local machining/tooling capability lead only. It does not establish railway-part capability, raw-material origin, current throughput, availability, certification, schedule, or prices.
iraq.scosi-extrusion-press-components-20.licence: Public page; reuse and redistribution terms unassessed

iraq.icsc-samawa-cement-plant.publisher: Iraqi Cement State Company, Ministry of Industry and Minerals
iraq.icsc-samawa-cement-plant.access: Official state-company page lists the Samawa cement plant under Iraqi Cement State Company. This is a local-source discovery lead only; current operating status, product grade/certificates, capacity, availability, delivery, price and suitability for the candidate mix are not confirmed by the page.
iraq.icsc-samawa-cement-plant.licence: Public page; reuse and redistribution terms unassessed
